The extensive workup including inflammatory markers, stool studies for infection, celiac serology, and calprotectin was negative, and your symptoms lack the systemic features (fever, weight loss, blood) or specific triggers (nighttime awakening) typical of organic disease. I have ruled out inflammatory bowel disease, infection, and malabsorption syndromes, leaving a functional gastrointestinal disorder as the most likely explanation.
